Pendapatan tumbuh rata-rata 16%/tahun dalam 3 tahun terakhir, kuartal terakhir +16% YoY.
Diuntungkan tema geopolitik Timur Tengah & Harga Minyak (intensitas 38/100): Konflik di Timur Tengah dan keputusan OPEC+ menggerakkan harga minyak.
Relative strength kuat: mengungguli S&P 500 sebesar 12% dalam 6 bulan.

summary: General Electric Company, doing business as GE Aerospace, designs and produces commercial and defense aircraft engines, integrated engine components, electric power, and aircraft systems. The company operates through two segments, Commercial Engines & Services, and Defense & Propulsion Technologies.
